test_cases.prompt: We just redesigned Bistrot Creperie's menu. It went from 5 pages to 4, dark chalkboard aesthetic, gold accents, baroque frames. We want to show the design and tell the story of the condensed process.
test_cases.evaluation: Should output a spec that positions this as heritage/craft storytelling (Chanel) with artistic depth (Valentino)

test_cases.prompt: DIFRESH is launching a new automation tool for creative studios. It's about efficiency + creativity. We want to position this as a game-changer for designers and teams.
test_cases.evaluation: Should blend Givenchy's minimalism (clean, technical) with Nike's directness (action-oriented, empowering)

test_cases.prompt: Behind-the-scenes content: showing the design process for A Sip of Art packaging. Close-ups of hands, sketches, refinement stages. Want to show the artisanal side of our work.
test_cases.evaluation: Should emphasize craft storytelling (Hermès) and artistic vision (Valentino)

test_cases.prompt: New seasonal product line (Teacasso Iced Tea fall collection). Bold launch. Want to feel premium, seasonal, artistic.
test_cases.evaluation: Should blend Dior's drama (seasonal, artistic) with Givenchy's minimalism (refined, intentional)

test_cases.prompt: Daily DIFRESH Instagram post about our work. Just want it to look premium, not generic.
test_cases.evaluation: When no specific brief is given, should default to DIFRESH blend (Givenchy + Chanel + Hermès)

evaluation_criteria.brand_matching: Does the suggested brand inspiration fit the brief?
evaluation_criteria.layout_appropriateness: Is the layout recommendation useful for the content type?
evaluation_criteria.color_palette_quality: Are the color recommendations premium-feeling and brand-appropriate?
evaluation_criteria.copy_tone_alignment: Does the suggested copy tone match the brief and brand inspiration?
evaluation_criteria.actionability: Can a designer/content creator use this spec to actually create a post?
evaluation_criteria.premium_feeling: Does the spec elevate the perceived quality vs generic posts?
